title: B2-06 · Security and defence vocabulary (in the media)

blocks.text: B2-06 · Security and defence vocabulary (in the media)

Security and defence occupy part of the Arab news daily: ministries and armed forces, cooperation agreements, border crises, ceasefires, attacks and investigations. To understand these news and report them accurately, a specific vocabulary is needed, but above all caution is needed: the budgets of victims change from hour to hour, sources are often not verifiable, and the choice of a word (the "fighter," the "militian" or "terrorist") often reveals the point of view of those who write. In this unit you learn the vocabulary of the security institutions and the news about them, the prepositions of cause and circumstance typical of the chronicle, the way to report uncertain budgets and figures and the rules to bring back the words connotationed without making them own. The vocabulary is that of the newspapers: no technical or operational details. Three weeks, no trace of variety in parallel.

blocks.text: Materials This unit, root dictionary, voice synthesis scripts, tutor sessions
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognising security and defence institutions and their names in different countries;
2. understand news about cooperation, crisis, ceasefire and investigation, with prepositions of cause and condition ( ⁧إِثْرَ⁩ , ⁧جَرَّاءَ⁩ , ⁧عَلَى خَلْفِيَّةِ⁩ …);
3. reporting uncertain budgets and figures with the right formulas ( ⁧حَصِيلَة⁩ , ⁧مَا لَا يَقِلُّ عَنْ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَتَسَنَّ التَّحَقُّقُ⁩ …);
4. recognize the words and bring them back to the source;
5. read a news report of 330 words on these topics at least 80 words per minute.
